myCv.copyAria: Copy the request for your agent
myCv.askAgent: Your agent turns it into a template once (after that it uses no quota). It opens in a terminal, where you see and approve what it does.
myCv.recreated: From {{format}} the agent recreates the design: it'll look very similar, but not exact, and it only produces PDF. It needs an agent that can see images. If you have the Word file, upload it: it's kept as is.
myCv.title: My CV
myCv.intro: Upload your CV and your agent turns it into a template once. From then on, every tailored CV comes out with your design and your section order, with the text adapted to the job from your profile.
myCv.none: You haven't uploaded your CV yet
myCv.noneHint: Ideally in Word (.docx): the design is kept exactly. Maximum 10 MB.

title: CV templates
intro: Your agent writes the content of each CV; the template only decides how it looks. You can change it on each job's page without using AI again.

ats-simple.name: Simple ATS
ats-simple.description: One column, no photo or tables, with the contact details in the body and a standard typeface. The safe choice for job portals with an ATS.

carta-simple.name: Simple letter
carta-simple.description: One-column cover letter, no photo, in the CV's accent colour. Used when the CV template has no cover-letter design of its own.

clasica-foto.name: Classic with photo
clasica-foto.description: One column, header with a round photo and the accent colour on the name and headings. Understated, for sending by email or to companies without an ATS.

moderna-2col.name: Modern two-column
moderna-2col.description: Two columns with a coloured sidebar (round photo, contact, skills, languages and certifications) and the experience in the main column. PDF only. Not ATS-friendly (two columns).

actions.confirmBody: This deletes the template and the CV you uploaded to create it. CVs already generated keep their PDF and Word files.
actions.confirmDefault: This is your default template: from now on the app will choose one. This deletes the template and the CV you uploaded to create it. CVs already generated keep their PDF and Word files.
